mainEntity.name: Is $299 the whole monthly price for the receptionist?

acceptedAnswer.text: The published monthly phone price is $299. The receptionist is a $299 one-time setup, then $299 a month, billed month to month, with 30 days written notice to cancel. Front Door and Front Door + Growth are separate services with their own monthly prices on the pricing page.

mainEntity.name: Does the price change with call volume?

acceptedAnswer.text: The published phone price is $299 a month plus $299 setup. It is not a promise of unlimited capacity or a guaranteed answer time. Bring your expected monthly volume and busiest-hour demand to the demo so capacity, simultaneous calls and any usage terms can be confirmed in writing before you buy.
